key_insight: MarkovSim keeps LLM context bounded during long-horizon simulation by rebuilding compact progress summaries at finite-state workflow transitions.
engineering_relevance: For finite element analysis, the harness supports automated workflows and fault correction while reserving engineering judgment for human consultation.
method: Store workflow records in schema-defined memory.
Organize simulation tasks with a finite-state machine.
Construct compact agent context from memory at state transitions.
evidence_signal: Across six finite element benchmark problems, MarkovSim passed 16 of 18 runs, corrected solver-operation and model-physics faults, and maintained bounded context in every run.
watch_item: The six-problem evaluation leaves generalization to broader simulation tasks and the reliability of compact context summaries unestablished.
paper_title: MarkovSim: an LLM Agent Harness with Bounded Context for Long-Horizon Computational Simulation
